title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This strap-like muscle is the longest in your body.
Watch the long band crossing the front of the thigh.
Which muscle is glowing?
The rectus femoris is thicker and runs straight down the thigh.
This one slants from the front of the hip to the inner knee.
It's C. The sartorius.
Why it matters: its name comes from the Latin word for tailor.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This is the biggest muscle in the human body. Name it.
We're looking from behind at the hip.
Which muscle is glowing?
The gluteus medius lies partly beneath it, higher on the hip.
This one forms the bulk of your buttock and extends the hip.
It's B. The gluteus maximus.
Why it matters: it powers climbing stairs and standing up.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle group is it?
lines: Kick a ball, and this muscle group straightens your knee.
Watch the glowing muscles on the front of the thigh.
Which muscle group is it?
The hamstrings are on the back of the thigh.
These muscles run down the front and join at the kneecap.
It's D. The quadriceps.
Why it matters: they straighten the knee when you stand up or kick.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What does the glowing muscle do?
lines: A long muscle along the front of your shin moves your foot.
Watch the glowing muscle beside the shinbone.
What does the glowing muscle do?
Pointing the toes down is the job of the calf muscles.
This one pulls the top of the foot toward the shin.
It's B. It lifts the foot up.
Why it matters: it helps your toes clear the ground with every step.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What do these muscles do?
lines: Your inner thigh has muscles that squeeze your legs together.
Look at the glowing muscles along the inside of the thigh.
What do these muscles do?
The gluteus medius does the opposite and pushes the thigh outward.
It's B. They pull the thigh inward toward the midline.
Why it matters: you use them every time you squeeze your knees together.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which quad muscle is glowing?
lines: Your quadriceps has four heads. Can you spot this one?
Watch the glowing muscle low on the inner side of the thigh.
Which quad muscle is glowing?
The vastus lateralis is its partner on the outer side.
It's C. The vastus medialis.
Why it matters: it helps keep your kneecap tracking straight.

title: Leg Muscles
question: These muscles belong to which group?
lines: Bend your knee. The muscles at the back of the thigh do this.
We're looking from behind at the back of the thigh.
These muscles belong to which group?
The quadriceps are at the front of the thigh.
These two run down the back of the thigh and bend the knee.
It's B. The hamstrings.
Why it matters: the hamstrings extend the hip and bend the knee.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which calf muscle is glowing?
lines: Rise onto your toes. This muscle in your calf helps.
We're looking from behind at the lower leg.
Which calf muscle is glowing?
The gastrocnemius is the bulging calf muscle on top of it.
This flat muscle lies beneath the gastrocnemius.
It's A. The soleus.
Why it matters: it points the foot down when the knee is bent.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What does the glowing muscle do?
lines: Stand on one leg. A muscle on the side of your hip works hard.
We're looking from behind at the hip.
What does the glowing muscle do?
Straightening the knee is the job of the quadriceps.
This hip muscle stops the other side of your pelvis from dropping.
It's C. It keeps the pelvis level.
Why it matters: it works every time you walk or stand on one leg.
